title: Mylapore living room
description: A storeroom with tube lights and patched concrete becomes a living room with a red oxide floor, cleaned brick and an oonjal — under the original Madras-terrace roof.

before.alt: Bare room with grey concrete floor, cardboard boxes, tube lights and clouded windows under teak joists

after.alt: The same room with red oxide floor, sofa, oonjal, plants and clear windows

title: Mylapore kitchen
description: The far wall gets a teak kitchen with a black granite counter and green tiles, a granite-topped island and three cane stools.

before.alt: Bare wall with an old counter and boxes

after.alt: Teak kitchen with granite island, brass pendants and cane stools

title: Adyar living room
description: Beige vitrified tiles and a lone tube light give way to an Athangudi floor, an oonjal by the window, cane chairs and brass.

before.alt: Apartment room with plain beige tiles, yellowed walls, a tube light and boxes

after.alt: Finished living room with Athangudi tiles, oonjal and cane chairs
